browser_support_strategy: Local Windows platform; VP9 WebM and WebP are served from the local frontend. Live Chrome verified finite duration, decoded 1920x540 frames, autoplay, mute, inline playback, and native loop wrap. No reference-site runtime dependency is used.
preload_strategy: preload=none; lazy source attachment only when the Dashboard view is active and reduced-motion preference is not enabled
